appDescription: A rental car app that records the vehicle state at pickup and return so that the customer and the rental company keep the same record.

function.name: RENTAL_START_RETURN_CHECK
function.description: Opens the app and starts the return check, which shows what to check in the car before returning a rental car. It runs only during a rental while the car is in park.

function.name: RENTAL_WHAT_TO_CHECK
function.description: Answers what the user should check before returning a rental car, including open doors and windows, lights left on, and how much the battery changed since pickup. It works without opening the app.

function.name: RENTAL_SHOW_RECORD
function.description: Opens the app and shows the pickup record of the current rental with a QR code that copies the record to the user's phone.
